segments.title: Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown.

segments.title: Netanyahu Address & Biden Oval Office Speech
segments.notes: Case Blackwell (as Jeff Ripple) and Jeff Ripple cover Netanyahu's congressional address, Union Station protests, Harris statement, and Biden's withdrawal address.

segments.title: Viral Video Review: Barbecue Foot Massage, Hiding Spots, Frog Costume, Florida Valhalla, Coconut Crabs, Luigi
segments.notes: Case and Liliana review viewer-submitted clips including a 90-minute barbecue infomercial, a man's elaborate hiding spots, a frog-costumed dancer, a Florida concert venue, coconut crab prank, and a Luigi dance video.

segments.title: Frog vs. Luigi Dance Debate
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate whether the frog dancer or Luigi is the better dancer; Kendall calls in claiming Case's dancing triggered a seizure; Munch declares victory and delivers outro.

segments.title: Park Interviews: Couch Enthusiasts, Rob Elvie, Dr. Manhattan's Penis, Couch Pulley System, Bee Doppelganger
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein interviews park visitors including a Trump impersonator confessing to couch relations, Rob Elvie negotiating an unban, a blobfish claiming to be Dr. Manhattan's penis, a person humping Case's couch via pulley system, and a bee-faced Case doppelganger.

segments.title: Bodybuilder Marries Sex Doll / Gina Darling Birthday Raid
segments.notes: DJ Newsic performs an original song about bodybuilder Yuri Tolochko's marriage to a sex doll, his caveman identity, and previous relationships with an ashtray and chicken doll; broadcast ends with a birthday raid for Gina Darling.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: lead anchor. Anchored the Netanyahu/Biden news block as Jeff Ripple, hosted Amongst the Web with Liliana, and participated in the Munch & Crum dance debate.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the station sign-on and countdown at top of broadcast.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted the news desk with Case, reading wire copy on Netanyahu protests and Biden's address.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Joined Case for Amongst the Web video reviews, defending the frog dancer in the subsequent debate.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for Luigi in the dance debate, claimed victory, and delivered the segment outro.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Argued for the frog dancer, cited his mayoral run in Kremchen, and traded insults with Munch over debate scoring.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Called in to report that Case's dancing gave her a seizure, prompting epilepsy accusations.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted park interviews from the bushes, encountering a parade of surreal characters including a Trump couch enthusiast and a blobfish claiming to be Dr. Manhattan's penis.

lore_notes.fact: Kendelle claims Case's dancing triggered a seizure during the Munch & Crum debate.
Crum asserts he held majority female support during his mayoral campaign in Kremchen.
Broadcast concluded with a birthday raid for Gina Darling.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Netanyahu's congressional address and the surrounding protests, followed by Biden's Oval Office withdrawal speech. The Amongst the Web segment reviewed viral videos including a barbecue-foot-massage infomercial and a frog-costumed dancer, sparking a heated Munch & Crum debate adjudicated by a call-in from Kendelle. Trip Bradstein's park interviews descended into surreal encounters with a couch-obsessed Trump impersonator and a blobfish identifying as Dr. Manhattan's penis, before DJ Newsic closed the broadcast with a musical tribute to a bodybuilder's sex doll marriage and a birthday raid.
